diagnostics.message: `resource.local_file.public_ssh_key` declares `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content` is `tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh`, which already creates an implicit dependency on `resource.tls_private_key.ssh`. The explicit depends_on is redundant.

`resource.local_file.private_ssh_key` declares `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content` is `tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem`, which already creates an implicit dependency on `resource.tls_private_key.ssh`. The explicit depends_on is redundant.

`resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance` launches the runner agent instance whose user-data writes the registration token into `resource.aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token` via `put-parameter --overwrite`. Because the SSM parameter is created by Terraform with `overwrite` defaulting to false on create, the parameter must already exist before an instance boots; otherwise Terraform's create fails with "already exists". Nothing references the SSM parameter, so no ordering is enforced. Add an explicit dependency (e.g. `depends_on = [aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token]`) so the parameter is created first.
